raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be allowed to dispense"
    role subject "the pharmacist"
    role object "Euthyrox 50 µg"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "show"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the empty box"
  role recipient "the pharmacist"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "show"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "the expired compensated prescription from August"
  role recipient "the pharmacist"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
